## Try it on Windows

1. Download `MootCourtMemorialToolkit-…-windows.exe` below.
2. Double-click it. Windows may show "Windows protected your PC" because the file is not code-signed: choose **More info → Run anyway**.
3. A console window opens and your browser loads the app. Keep the window open while you work; close it to stop the app.

Nothing to install, and no internet connection is needed. Projects, uploaded memorials and reports stay on your computer in `%LOCALAPPDATA%\MootCourtMemorialToolkit`.

## What this version does

Checks a DOCX memorial against rules you enter: mandatory sections, word and page limits, formatting, heading consistency and footnotes, with a downloadable PASS / WARNING / FAIL report. All checks are rule-based; no AI is used and no competition's rules are built in.

Not included yet: PDF upload, AI review, Index of Authorities generation, version comparison, user accounts.
